best_for: CapitalRequest sets a page's reasons to buy as a capital request form already filled in: one paper sheet with a folded corner, a numbered field per reason with its text typed on the field line, an "Attach" link to the page that holds the source, and the references a reason rests on as mono boxes in the margin.

items.d: In creams, liquids and drinks, water is an ingredient. Water made and tested to a written specification protects your limits and shelf life.
Health Canada's good manufacturing practice guides ask for qualified, monitored water and its test records. GUI-0001 covers drugs; GUI-0158, natural health products.
Documentation scales to your product's rules: qualification records for drug lines, an acceptance test against your specification for the rest.
Sized to the water you use each day; adding lines later is a capacity upgrade.
